acceptance: The dependency query returns its graph result without starting ios_build or xcodebuild.
brief: A read-only UI dependency query unexpectedly starts an Xcode build and can collide with another child.
contract_evidence: Owner ops-engineer; current query probe spawned an isolated xcodebuild and terminated before a verdict. Contract investigation is split into IMP-20260818-17bdf8; next step is exact IndexStore evidence or a toolchain-free contract test.
detail: Running ops/ui_graph.py --type SettingsStatusValue --json emitted an isolated build and launched ios_build/xcodebuild before producing the dependency result; the read-only query must not acquire the iOS build lock or start Xcode.
plan: Make the UI graph type query use an existing index or an explicit no-build path, then add a regression check that proves no Xcode process is spawned.
